$schema: Dialogue line schema (bible §16.7). Every line external to scene logic; scenes select lines by protagonist via characterVariant and branchCondition.

lineFields.voiceAsset: audio/ path or null (browser TTS fallback)
lineFields.subtitleTiming: {start, end} relative to scene start | null
lineFields.emotion: neutral | dry | tense | warm | clinical | menacing | weary | sharp
lineFields.characterVariant: protagonist id this line variant belongs to | null (shared)
